name: Native bridge: Chaos and Cosmos on the game's Nyx runtime
body: C++ static library in crates/chaos-ui/native: plain nodes implementing Umbra::IWidget, a ChaosNyxDriver on the game's runtime, Cosmos stylesheets loaded from the game's ui directory, and a C API (create, mount, unmount, tick, snapshot of nodes with resolved styles, dispatch an event, diagnostics). Built by nyx-sys's CMake build behind a `chaos-ui` feature so Nyx is compiled once. Needs a Nyx-side way to reach the C++ runtime behind a nyx_runtime* (GAME-F04-T01).

comments.text: Done 2026-10-30. crates/chaos-ui/native: UiNode implements Umbra::IWidget and Cosmos::IStyleTarget; C API in lantern_chaos_ui.h; one CMake superproject builds Nyx, Chaos, Cosmos and the bridge (nyx-sys feature chaos-ui). Needs nyx-host-interop.hpp (Nyx GAME-F04-T01). D-043.
